metadata.scope: Original trilogy; Andor seasons 1–2; The Clone Wars (2008) seasons 1–7 and film; The Mandalorian seasons 1–3; Ahsoka season 1; Rogue One; The Book of Boba Fett season 1; prequel trilogy; Rebels seasons 1–4 (66 watch records covering 74 official numbered slots); The Bad Batch seasons 1–3; Obi-Wan Kenobi six-part series; Solo: A Star Wars Story; sequel trilogy.

extensionCollections.note: Three separately sourced sequel films; release-type and runtime caveats retained.
Standalone film; U.S. theatrical release date separately sourced.

Six separately numbered episodes, Part I through Part VI. Shared premiere date does not combine records; edition-specific runtimes withheld. A Jedi’s Return is a behind-the-scenes special excluded separately from the original nine-special cohort.
15 individually numbered episodes. Same-day releases remain separate records; no combined episode ranges. Runtimes withheld pending edition-specific verification.

16 individually numbered season-two episodes. Same-day premiere, midseason and finale releases retain distinct episode IDs matching official guides. Provider titles/dates retained, including Truth & Consequences punctuation; runtimes withheld. Season 3 is catalogued in its own source file.

16 consecutive season-one records, matching official episode-guide numbers. Extended premiere remains episode1, not a split record. Provider dates retained; runtimes withheld pending edition verification. Seasons 2 and 3 are catalogued in their own source files.

13 watch records cover 15 official Disney+ numbered slots. Heroes of Mandalore (1–2) and In the Name of the Rebellion (3–4) share records matching official galleries. Finale remains slot 15, not invented 15–16; numbered slots are not a claim about narrative segments or broadcast length. Both provider URLs retained for combined pairs. Provider dates retained with regional-release caveat; title encoding repaired for finale.

19 watch records cover 22 official parts. Steps Into Shadow (1–2), Ghosts of Geonosis (12–13), and Zero Hour (21–22) use combined records matching official gallery granularity. TVmaze combines the premiere but splits both other pairs; raw records and both URLs are retained. No duplicate part 2, 13 or 22 progress items. Season 2 Recap special excluded.

20 watch records cover 22 official parts. The Siege of Lothal covers parts 1–2; Twilight of the Apprentice covers parts 21–22. No duplicate part 2 or 22 record. Ordinary provider numbers 2–19 normalize to official parts 3–20. The Ultimate Guide special is excluded.

Fourteen watch records cover fifteen official episode parts. Spark of Rebellion is one combined record covering parts 1–2; subsequent provider numbers 1–13 map to official numbers 3–15. The combined premiere is not imported again as a special or phantom second progress item. Four introductory shorts are outside this bounded season collection.
Three separately sourced prequel films; no edition-specific runtime claims.
Standalone film, separate from the original audit cohort.
Complete first season only; no season 2 future stubs.
Complete seven-chapter season; narrative order retains flashbacks.

metadata.chronologyNote: Catalog release dates are not story chronology. This catalog carries no story-order data: items have no storyOrder values and none are inferred. Viewing-sequence orders are supplied separately from this catalog metadata.
metadata.episodeReleaseDateNote: TVmaze airdate field retained as reported; territorial release times are not normalized.

filmReleaseDateNotes.st-force-awakens: 2015-12-18 from official landing page; territory and release type unspecified.
filmReleaseDateNotes.st-last-jedi: 2017-12-15 North American theatrical debut per Disney corporate release report; December 14 previews and December 13 international rollout are distinct.
filmReleaseDateNotes.st-rise-of-skywalker: 2019-12-20 domestic theatrical opening per Disney corporate report; December 18 international opening explains the film landing-page date.
filmReleaseDateNotes.solo: 2018-05-25 is explicitly U.S. theatrical release in the official poster gallery. Official film landing page lists 2018-05-23 without territory/type; these claims are retained separately.
filmReleaseDateNotes.pt-phantom-menace: 1999-05-19 from the official film landing page; territory and release type not explicitly specified.
filmReleaseDateNotes.pt-attack-of-the-clones: 2002-05-16 from the official film landing page; territory and release type not explicitly specified.
filmReleaseDateNotes.pt-revenge-of-the-sith: 2005-05-19 from the official film landing page; territory and release type not explicitly specified.
filmReleaseDateNotes.rogue-one: 2016-12-16 from the official film landing page; territory and release type not explicitly specified.
filmReleaseDateNotes.ot-a-new-hope: SWAPI provider release date retained; no territory or release-type field was supplied.
filmReleaseDateNotes.ot-empire-strikes-back: SWAPI 1980-05-17 retained as provider-reported date. Premiere versus theatrical release and territory remain unresolved; not a definitive worldwide release date.
filmReleaseDateNotes.ot-return-of-the-jedi: SWAPI 1983-05-25 retained, supported by the official Jedi at 40 article. Official film landing page previously displayed conflicting May 1; release-type provenance still needs normalization.
filmReleaseDateNotes.clone-wars-film: 2008-08-15 from official film landing page, checked 2026-11-07; territory not explicitly supplied in the extracted page.
